# TLDRLegal

> Plain English explanations of open source software licenses with expert-verified summaries for compliance and understanding.

TLDRLegal demystifies complex open source licenses by providing clear, accessible summaries of popular licenses like GPL, Apache, BSD, and LGPL. The site helps developers and organizations quickly understand licensing terms, obligations, and compatibility without legal jargon.

## Key Topics

- open-source-license
- license-explanation

- BSD 3-Clause License

## Core Resources

- [TLDRLegal Homepage](https://www.tldrlegal.com): Main entry point for looking up open source licenses in plain English
- [Browse Licenses](https://www.tldrlegal.com/browse): Browse and compare open source licenses with plain English summaries
- [Verified Licenses](https://www.tldrlegal.com/verified): Expert-reviewed license summaries verified for legal compliance

## Copyleft & Strong Reciprocal Licenses

- [GNU General Public License v3 (GPL-3)](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/gnu-general-public-license-v3-gpl-3): GPL-3 copyleft license explained with compliance requirements outlined
- [GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 (LGPL-2.1)](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/gnu-lesser-general-public-license-v2-1-lgpl-2-1): LGPL-2.1 license explained in plain English with key terms clarified
- [Common Development and Distribution License (CDDL-1.0)](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/common-development-and-distribution-license-cddl-1-0-explained): CDDL-1.0 weak copyleft license with patent grants explained simply

## Permissive Licenses

- [Apache License 2.0 (Apache-2.0)](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/apache-license-2-0-apache-2-0): Apache License 2.0 permissive license explained with patent protections
- [BSD 3-Clause License (Revised)](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/bsd-3-clause-license-revised): BSD 3-Clause permissive license with copyright notice requirements
- [OpenSSL License](https://www.tldrlegal.com/license/openssl-license-openssl): OpenSSL BSD-style license with advertising clause explained plainly
